plan.selection_rule: Mean clean/noisy F1 gain >=0.005, nonnegative clean F1 gain, accuracy/typo F1 drop <=0.005 against same-split reference
plan.confirmation_rule: Refit fresh model on 85% for fixed selected epoch count; mean F1 gain >=0.01 and same nonregression limits against refitted reference
plan.validation_rule: Fresh refit on full training for selected epoch count; same >=0.01 mean F1 and nonregression criteria against saved baseline
plan.test_rule: Only a validation-qualified checkpoint is evaluated; release requires positive F1 gain, positive paired-template bootstrap lower bound and accuracy/typo declines <=0.005
plan.limits: Previously explored development corpus; hash collisions and mean-pooling limits remain; original benchmark is not new external confirmation
